reason: The hypothesis directly restates the well-known strategy from P1 and P3 of adding Al+Ti to an FCC HEA to form a γ/γ′ microstructure for high-temperature strength, merely transferring it to a Ti-Ni-primary alloy without new mechanistic insight or integration of conflicting evidence. The core idea is a textbook precipitation-hardening approach already demonstrated in similar HEAs.

γ′ phase as ordered FCC (L12) coherent with FCC matrix
enhanced thermal stability and coarsening resistance at ~800 °C
